definitions.surfaceCin: RAP surface-based CIN analysis; normalized to negative J/kg
definitions.mixedLayerCape: RAP 90-mb mixed-layer CAPE analysis; nearest available match to SPC's 100-mb product
definitions.mixedLayerCin: RAP 90-mb mixed-layer CIN analysis; normalized negative and compared with SPC's 100-mb product
definitions.mostUnstableCape: RAP most-unstable CAPE from the lowest-255-mb parcel search layer
definitions.lowLevelLapseRate: Derived 0-3 km AGL lapse rate from RAP pressure-level temperature and height
definitions.midLevelLapseRate: Derived RAP 700-500 mb lapse rate from pressure-level temperature and height
definitions.lclHeight: Derived surface-parcel LCL AGL from RAP 2 m temperature/dewpoint spread
definitions.bulkShear6km: Derived RAP 10 m to 6 km AGL bulk wind difference
